name: Langerwehe (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically yellow and green, charged at the top with the municipal arms of Langerwehe (a black lion on yellow and white pottery jugs on green).
history: Municipal flag of Langerwehe; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Langerwehe arms — lion and pottery jugs
